import json, re, chess
rules = json.load(open("/app/re.json"))
def run_solution(fen):
    s = fen
    for p, r in rules:
        s = re.sub(p, r, s)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in s.split("\n")]

def compare(fen, verbose=False):
    our = run_solution(fen)
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    py = set()
    for mv in b.legal_moves:
        if mv.promotion and mv.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(mv)
        py.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    bad = [x for x in our if not (x in py or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in py)]
    ok = (not bad) and len(our) == len(py)
    if not ok or verbose:
        print(("OK " if ok else "FAIL ") + fen, "our", len(our), "py", len(py))
        if not ok:
            for x in bad: print("   bad:", x)
            print("   py:", sorted(py))
    return ok
